title: ISO 8601 duration to seconds
description: Implement parse_duration(text). Parse an ISO 8601 duration such as 'P1DT2H30M' or 'PT0.5S' and return the total number of seconds as a float. Supported designators: W, D (before T) and H, M, S (after T). Raise ValueError for anything else.
invariants: Years and months (Y, or M before T) are rejected with ValueError.
'P' alone, 'PT' alone, a missing 'P', empty text and a 'T' with nothing after it are ValueError.
Only the seconds field may be fractional (dot decimal).
Designators must appear in order W, D, then T then H, M, S.
